body:
# the contributor audits of three new bounded mechanisms

These are auxiliary proof audits. None establishes unrestricted OC.

## Seven-base global and microscopic response: PASS

Read candidate 501dba519aa398a9
in full. The uniform gap for caps not capturing the owned R follows
from the positive reflected simplex profile on a fixed neighborhood
of g. The finite six-base tilt captures all of R while retaining
every pair shift and excluding the other core fibers. Its cost is
uniformly below the bad-owned-trace gap for small t. This proves the
exact local identity before any weak convergence is used.

Canonical upper bounds put every six- and seven-base local maximizer
in that neighborhood by O(t), proving equality of their maximizing
sets and the exact finite-t global max identity. The isolators at
the other anchors still exclude R. Strict leading coefficients give
the stated base classifications; ties are correctly left to additional
source information.

For microscopic full-dimensional Hausdorff limits, the indicator L1
convergence, bounded support, and null limiting hyperplanes justify
moving normal/threshold convergence. Rescaling the free shift keeps
its minima in a common compact interval. The factor t/t^(1/d) tends
to zero exactly for d>=2, as required. No convergence rate or equality
of prelimit volumes to their limits is silently assumed. The earlier
all-normal simplex response proof applies with the new cap costs.

Checked the positive-orthant cube example in every d: J_0=0,
J_i=1 for i>=1; the proposed displacement satisfies every balanced
equation. The strict global coefficient identifies the actual base
and all maximizing selections, without asserting unsupported finite-t
uniqueness. the contributor reran the verifier:12 moving expansions,96 pair/tilt
checks,29 dimensional balances PASS.

## Corner-localized cap-distance stability: PASS

Read candidate f1516303d16df6d4
in full. Arbitrary missing sets supported inside the small vertex
neighborhoods are wholly included or wholly excluded by every relevant
cap. Thus only their volumes affect the exact local product formula;
polyhedrality or parallel cuts are unnecessary.

At the displayed candidate, the product expansion's error is bounded
by4t^2/Gamma. The constants in the normalized gain and its cutoff
t<=Gamma a_d/8 are correct. For K subset T, TV of their normalized
uniform laws equals the removed fraction exactly; the comparison to
the affine simplex infimum is in the correct direction. No optimal
comparison is assumed to exist.

For the quadrilateral diagnostic, checked its area, the enclosing
triangle intercept, the two incident cut fractions, and tau=hk/(1+h-k).
The support hypothesis holds as both parameters tend to zero. The
exact planar formula and second-order coefficient follow from the
audited all-corner law. the contributor reran verifier30254 PASS.

## Own-depth inner levels and selector obstruction: PASS

Read candidate 9402605e47a1b4ef
in full. Joint concavity is explicitly identified as archived. The
additional equality criterion retains actual active caps and does not
claim homothety of entire fibers. Upper semicontinuity at boundary
bases follows by compact cap inclusion and outer-neighborhood volume,
including zero-volume fibers.

Checked the exact vertex-to-centroid ray formula, high-level local
product inequalities, the reflected-simplex scaling and its constant.
In dimension two, integrating the ordered barycentric chambers gives
the stated logarithmic level-volume law and mean7V^2/54. The absolute
and relative levels are correctly distinguished; the interval example
is an actual convex source.

Layer cake yields depth-weighted volume, not uniform source volume.
The positive-mixture obstruction follows by approaching the boundary
through positive-volume layers and isolating any atom at level zero.
The upper layer-volume bound uses the continuous uniform probability
transform for a fixed projection; the lower bound uses the concave
depth-root tent. Sharpness is not overstated for actual d>=2 roots.

The high-level selector counter uses three original closed caps which
cover every point of the retained positive-area regions. The endpoint
gap dominates the prescribed delta increase, and the middle cap's
threshold lies below the entire retained region. The absolute-level
version retains exactly the larger left fiber. This refutes only the
specified high levels and centroid combinations, as stated.
The verifier requires the local math virtualenv for sympy; rerunning
there gives156 exact checks PASS.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
